deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 51% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 8% last year; 3%/yr over 3 years — the market expects faster growth than the company has recently delivered.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 5% (3 years ago 33%, falling) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $5 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 4% (3 years ago 20%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $10.7B, up 11% from a year ago — about 10% of the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $8.8B, up 17% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Inventory up 15% vs quarterly sales up -0% (days of inventory 48 → 57). Products may be building up unsold — a warning sign in chip cycles.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 3%/yr over 3 years and 17%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 3% vs a 5-year range of 3–17% (median 8%): near the bottom of its range (possible cycle low).
deeper.margin_position: near the bottom of its range (possible cycle low)

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: No buybacks or dividends reported over the last 12 months. Share count up 0.4% from a year ago (about flat).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $2.16, down 4% in 90 days (down 4% in the last 30); 11 analysts raised, 17 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $1.72, down 3% in 90 days; 12 analysts raised, 16 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest quarter vs a year earlier: Automotive 90% of sales, up 2%; Energy generation and storage segment 10% of sales, down 16%. Source: 10-Q XBRL.

deeper.title: Insider trading
deeper.text: Last 90 days: no open-market purchases; sales $938k, 0% under pre-set 10b5-1 trading plans. Source: SEC Form 4.

deeper.title: New risk factors
deeper.text: 3 new risk-factor headings vs last year's annual report, e.g. “Our future growth and success are dependent upon demand for our electric vehicles and adoption of autonomous d…”; “Growth of our business is also dependent upon our ability to develop and commercialize Bots, including Optimus…”.

tiles.sub: -4% vs a year ago · $0.93 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Both profit per share and sales are flat or down from a year ago (latest quarter vs a year earlier): no growth right now.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: A mixed record: 3 beats in the last 8 quarters, so results are hard to predict.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter 0% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $103.6B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales are flat vs a year earlier: the business isn't growing right now.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $3 of operating profit, about the same as a year ago.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 101% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 456× last year's profit (its highest in 5 years); only 175× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Jan 27; analysts expect EPS of $0.50, about the same as a year ago. It usually moves about 5% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
